ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity dark region concentrated at the central peduncle insertion, radiating outward in striated patterns. High-intensity white contiguous areas occupy the majority of the lateral lobes. Distinct dark focal spots are present on the distal portions of both lobes, particularly the right.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees and a moderate depth-to-span ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude, more jagged peaks near the distal tip compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex curvature along the outer lateral margins, sweeping into sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Multiple isolated dark circular focal spots are distributed across the interior of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, long diagonal linear mark on the upper-mid section of the left lobe; multiple shorter, unaligned linear marks visible near the lower margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique vertical alignment of three distinct dark circular spots on the distal third of the right lobe.
